name: White River
blurb: White River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

putInAccess.operator: Wildlife Biologist (ownership 'Wisconsin DNR' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency-listed access area; the marker does not identify the exact water-edge landing. Confirm the signed approach and current access conditions with the site manager. DNR notes that non-DNR sites in this inventory are not actively maintained.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public approach to Radley Bridge Road Landing. The map shows the access area; find the designated landing on arrival and check current site conditions.
